notes.title: 0.16 major demo update
notes.notes:
Added a new blitz mode (20-40 minutes depending on difficulty level).

Also added:
[list]
[*] New Achievements
[*] Some of the Achievements give bonuses for the normal adventure mode
[*] New spell - "Fire Storm"
[*] New spell - "Toxic Cloud".
[*] New specializations of strength and dexterity.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=KbmELz_dKGs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 0.15 demo update
notes.notes:
Added:

[list]
[*] Tutorial level
[*] Blacksmith in the village (can improve equipment for gold)
[*] New artifacts
[*] New melee weapons
[*] Restoration and improvement of destroyed huts, road building
[*] New specializations (can be purchased in rebuilt healer and shaman huts)
[*] Permanent base upgrades for the blacksmith and construction
[*] Achievements
[*] New markers on the map, option to hide markers
[/list]

Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.14.2
notes.notes:
Increased the chance of an altar appearing in a dungeon room.
Additional magic workbench on each floor after the level with the mini-boss.
Improved dungeon procedural generation algorithm.
Some balance fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.14.1
notes.notes: Fixed a few minor bugs with weapon improvements.

notes.title: Demo version major update 0.14
notes.notes:
Added:

[list]
[*] Nine new weapons specializations
[*] New wizard specializations: focus, master of magic, stay away
[*] New intellect specializations: pyromancer 4, full mental panic
[*] New strength specializations: berserker 4, tirelessness
[*] New ranged weapon: slime bomb
[*] New melee weapons: katar, wide katar, triple katar, slime staff
[*] More usefull trader interface
[*] Ability to improve weapons on a magic workbench
[/list]

Increased the shooting area of crossbows
Reduced cost of weapons

[previewyoutube=DaSyxlPWBDo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 0.13.2
notes.notes:
Fixed some minor bugs.
Increased by 20% chance (local) to drop food from enemies (if the enemy had a drop chance of 5%, now it's 120% of 5 = 6%)
Added:
Two new specializations for the shieldbearer - "Master Shieldbearer" (Completely removes the penalty to a critical attack) and "Protection from Magic"
New sets for artifacts:
[olist]
[*] "Fast Attack" (reduces the chance of enemy dodge)
[*] "Energy Conservation" (chance of free use of magic and skills)
[*] "Resilience" (chance of avoiding a negative condition (poisoning, bleeding, etc.))
[*] "Hunter" (increases hunter's mark chance)
[*] "Dodger" (increases dodge chance)
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo version major update 0.10
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BID5IHVVDa8;full][/previewyoutube]

Added:
Fast combat option.
New hero with extra perks - Maj Mun (@).
Two new adventures in the style of classic roguelikes. Small floors, high tempo, accelerated progression. 
New miniBoss.
New food - rations.
New potions.
New artifacts.
New suffixes and prefixes for enemies.
Goblin merchants.
Orbs for remote communication with NPCs.
The condition of satiety temporarily increases the 4 main attributes.
The conditions of poisoning, bleeding, stuns, etc. temporarily decrease attributes.

notes.title: Demo version update 0.9.3
notes.notes:
Added: music, new artifacts, new mobs (for the night island), new food, new specializations.
Fixed bugs with moving and attacking ranged mobs.
Fixed bug with the upgrade of the dagger.
Added telepathy potion that shows the visibility area of mobs and their hp.
